name: Addons overview screen
description:
### Why?

Part of  ("[Portal] Addons — dev & testing"). The new Partner Portal needs a "Moje doplňky → Přehled" screen per . That data and UI already exist as the "Addons" tab of ApiPartnerController (admin/controllers/ApiPartnerController.php:165) — this ticket exposes it in Partner Portal too, without duplicating the implementation.

### What?

New controller under admin/controllers/PartnerPortal/ (same shape as PartnerPortalOverviewController: Inertia #[Component], RequiresActiveModule('partnerPortal')) renders the addons table matching the Figma frame — columns Datum, Jméno doplňku, Kategorie, Uživatelé, Cena, Objednatelné, Premium, Schváleno, plus Filtr.

The listing logic/screen is shared, not copied: both the new Partner Portal route and the existing ApiPartnerController::adminAddonsAction render off one implementation. The existing ApiPartner Addons tab keeps working unchanged in parallel — no removal, no regression.

The "Přidat nový doplněk" CTA opens the existing add-addon flow (PartnerServiceAddController, already linked via AddAddonButton.tsx) — this is a relocation so it's reachable from Partner Portal, not new functionality.

### Acceptance Criteria

New Partner Portal controller renders the addons overview screen matching Figma node 531:9225 (table + Filtr + CTA)

Addon-listing logic is extracted/shared so ApiPartnerController's existing Addons tab and the new Partner Portal screen use the same implementation, not a copy

Existing ApiPartner Addons tab verified unchanged (no regression)

"Přidat nový doplněk" button on the new screen opens the existing PartnerServiceAdd flow — no new addon-creation logic

New screen gated behind RequiresActiveModule('partnerPortal')

Unit/PHPUnit coverage for the new/shared controller logic; Vitest coverage for the new page component
